entities.name: Thorn
entities.description: One of the Northern Provinces during the Dark Age of Terisiare, established in the wake of Argive; it fell to the frost in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Nation that survived into the Dark Age after the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Northern Provinces
entities.description: Loose farmsteads, villages and city-states that formed from Argive's collapse.

entities.name: Dark Age
entities.description: Period of Terisiare closed by Tivadar's Crusade.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Period when Thorn fell to the frost.

entities.name: Tivadar
entities.description: Legend of the Church of Tal born in Thorn, who reformed the Church to focus on rampaging goblins.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church reformed by Tivadar; it fell apart once the goblins were driven back.

entities.name: Tivadar's Crusade
entities.description: Crusade that threw back the Goblin Invasions and ended the Dark Age.

entities.name: Goblin Invasions
entities.description: Invasions thrown back by Tivadar and his knights.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: Hardy people who re-settled the land of Thorn.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Terrain that later included Thorn's land after the Thaw.

events.summary: Thorn is established in the wake of Argive and sustains itself through the Dark Age, eventually falling to the frost of the Ice Age.
events.quote: Thorn was established in the wake of Argive

events.summary: Tivadar is born in Thorn and later reforms the Church of Tal to focus on goblins.
events.quote: Tivadar would eventually reform the Church to focus on the threat of the rampaging goblins

events.summary: With his Knightly Order and Rasputin Dreamweaver, Tivadar throws back the Goblin Invasions, ending the Dark Age.
events.quote: he and his Knightly Order, aided by the wizard Rasputin Dreamweaver , temporarily restored civilization to Terisiare

events.summary: Long after its abandonment, Thorn's land is re-settled by the Kjeldorans and later included in New Argive.
events.quote: the land of former Thorn would later be re-settled by the hardy Kjeldorans

relations.quote: aided by the wizard Rasputin Dreamweaver
